answers.question: Which dogs are of the rarest breed? Show their names and treatment dates.
answers.generated_answer:
<think>

</think>

SELECT
    d.name,
    t.date_of_treatment
FROM
    dogs d
JOIN
    treatments t ON d.dog_id = t.dog_id
JOIN
    breeds b ON d.breed_code = b.breed_code
JOIN
    sizes s ON d.size_code = s.size_code
JOIN
    treatment_types tt ON t.treatment_type_code = tt.treatment_type_code
WHERE
    b.breed_name IN (
        SELECT breed_name
        FROM breeds
        ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
        LIMIT 1
    )
GROUP BY
    d.name,
    t.date_of_treatment;
